messages:
hannah: quick follow-up from yesterday's postmortem. we have 4 open actions — need single R/A, jira links, and short AC so nothing stalls.
miguel: i'll take the cache-rotation fix, ticket PMT-12001. R: miguel, A: hannah, C: ravi. ETA Fri EOD.
ravi: i'll consult on rollout and add a rollback one-liner to the ticket. saw this pattern twice in Q1.
jin: added a short test plan comment to PMT-12001 and set label `postmortem:followup`.
hannah: thanks. for the TTL-skip trend (PMT-12008) can someone own the trend analysis and add a 30-day histogram? prefer a single epic if recurring.
ravi: i'll own PMT-12008. ETA Tue morning. will attach Grafana panel link and link to previous incidents.
pm-bot: PMT-12001 assigned to miguel; reminder set for 2026-04-04T17:00:00Z.
miguel: small process ask  let's enforce one R + one A on each ticket and require a 1-line acceptance criteria: `repro; metric; PR; canary pass`. keeps closures fast.
hannah: agreed. jin, can you create an epic for recurring infra patterns and link both tickets?
jin: done  EPIC-12050 created and linked PMT-12001 and PMT-12008. dashboard placeholder: https://grafana.internal/d/p12050 (WIP).
ravi: for the RACI doc update  can someone add a "postmortem baton" section with interim owner rules (48h handover if R unavailable)?
miguel: i can draft that small section and open a PR. will include an audit-close field: who closed + timestamp.
hannah: timeline lock: PMT-12001 -> Fri EOD, PMT-12008 -> Tue AM. 15m sync Mon 10:00 UTC to check canary/readouts. everyone, update Jira AC before the sync.
jin: adding AC to tickets now.
pm-bot: Follow-up sync scheduled for 2026-04-06T10:00:00Z.
hannah: thanks all — marking thread as follow-up in progress. :white_check_mark:
